notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
- Improved navigation system mesh for NPCs on level 2.
- Decreased start fire delay on Rapid Gun.

notes.title: First game feedback
notes.content: Hello everyone, this is my first game. Yes, it is not perfect and there's a lot of room for improvement. But I'll be here, listen and paying attention to your feedback and keep on improving. Regards.
